title: Yellow Fermented Japanese Fish Ramen
description: A creamy and bitter Japanese fish ramen dish featuring fish sauce and fermented ingredients, perfect for a hangover cure. This flexitarian-friendly meal is a unique twist on traditional ramen.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, aekjeot, and fermented soybean paste.
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add the green onions and bok choy.
Cook the green onions and bok choy until they are softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the pickled ginger to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
To assemble the ramen, place the cooked noodles in a bowl and add the flaked cod fish, soft boiled egg, and cooked green onions and bok choy.
Pour the fish sauce mixture over the top of the ramen and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional green onions and pickled ginger if desired.
Serve the ramen hot and enjoy.
